parts.1:
1 What are they going to have for lunch?
Mum: Pete, would you like some pasta for lunch today?
Pete: There's some pizza left ... We didn't eat it all last night.
Mum: Don't you want something different? I can make a salad if you don't want pasta.
Pete: I'm fine with the same as last night.
Mum: OK then. Lunch won't be long.
2 Which family are Emily's new neighbours?
Emily: A new family has moved into the flat next to us. I met them yesterday.
Sean: What are they like?
Emily: Great. There's the grandma, she's really friendly, and two children, about my age, I think.
Sean: Like you and your brother?
Emily: Just girls. Their dad's a photographer and their mum's a teacher.
3 What was Oscar doing when Isabel phoned him?
Isabel: Hi, Oscar, it's Isabel.
Oscar: Oh, hi. How are you? Listen, I can't talk for long, sorry.
Isabel: No problem. Are you having your dinner?
Oscar: I'm helping my dad move the furniture in my bedroom. And then we're going to paint the walls.
Isabel: Wow! Don't worry, I'll send you a text later. Have fun painting!
4 Why didn't Niesha go to the party?
Boy: Hi, Niesha, why didn't you go to Jack's party on Saturday? Were you sick?
Niesha: I was when I missed the sports day at school, but I missed the party because we were driving back from holiday.
Boy: Did you visit your aunt – the one who's a chef?
Niesha: Yes, we had amazing dinners every night!
5 Where's Oliver's phone now?
Oliver: Have you seen my mobile anywhere?
Poppy: I think it was on the kitchen table earlier.
Oliver: I've used it since then ... did I put it on the desk afterwards?
Poppy: You often leave it on the sofa when you're watching TV.
Oliver: Ah, I was right. Look – I couldn't see it because of the books.
parts.2:
Woman: Hi. Today you're going to do your project. It's called Helping because it's about what people do to look after animals.
First, you're going to do a drawing. It's difficult to draw a monkey because they move so much, so you're going to draw a tiger.
Water is very important for our animals, and at ten forty-five you're going to go with our staff to give some animals their water. Then, at eleven thirty, you'll see our youngest animal. He's really beautiful; he's a baby lion. He's called Sohatu. I'll spell that for you, so you can find out more about him on our website. It's S-O-H-A-T-U.
After that, you'll see the dolphins. Some dolphins can live to be sixty years old, but our oldest dolphin is thirty-seven. He's about one hundred kilos and two metres long.
At the end of the day, we'll give you a present – a poster. You can also go to the shop and buy perhaps a T-shirt or a toy.
parts.3:
Jasmine: Thank you for taking me camping with you last weekend, Aunt Lizzie.
Lizzie: It was great, wasn't it, Jasmine? Especially when we went swimming. It was too windy to swim in the sea, but the lake was great anyway. Perhaps next time we can try the river.
Jasmine: Sleeping in a tent was new for me. I was worried about it on the first night, but I soon found out how exciting it is! My brother was very unhappy that he couldn't come with us.
Lizzie: Cooking was fun. Well, sometimes. It was difficult to cook the omelette, but I loved grilling the steak on a barbecue. Did you like the pasta I made?
Jasmine: Yes, I was really hungry that day.
Lizzie: The campsite was quite big, but it's a pity they didn't have anywhere to buy food and things. And the showers were a bit dirty, but OK. Which activity did you like best?
Jasmine: Well, running in the forest was OK, but hard. But fishing was amazing, even more fun than cycling!
Lizzie: I'm glad you had a good time.
parts.4:
16 You will hear a girl, Teresa, talking to her friend. Who's Teresa waiting for?
Steve: Hi Teresa, why are you waiting outside the school gates?
Teresa: My aunt's picking me up today because we're going into the centre to buy some birthday presents.
Steve: Do you think she'd take my brother? She knows him. He's in your class. He's talking to Mr Harrison, the new sports coach, over there.
Teresa: Let's ask her. That's her car.
17 You will hear a boy phoning his mother. Why is he phoning her?
Boy: Mum, I'm still at school at the moment. If it's OK with you, I'd like to go to Frank's house after school because we want to work on our science project together. All right? And Frank's mum's said I can have dinner with them too. I hope you haven't already cooked something for me.
18 You will hear two friends talking about a new café. How will they find out where the new café is?
Boy: Let's go to that new café after school. Do you know where it is?
Girl: I tried to go online earlier to find out, but the wi-fi wasn't working. Isn't there a big notice about it on the wall in the library?
Boy: You're right, let's go and read it. Has anyone in our class been to the café yet?
Girl: Sophia has.
19 You will hear a girl and her dad talking about a boat tour. Why do they decide to go on the boat tour today?
Dad: How about going on a boat tour today?
Girl: Yes! I don't mind that the weather's a bit cloudy.
Dad: Uncle Pablo works for the tour company and he's telling tourists about the history of the town when they're on the boat today!
Girl: I'd love to hear him!
Dad: Me too. I'll book our tickets online. It isn't cheaper, but it's more convenient.
20 You will hear a boy, Hugo, talking to his teacher. What must Hugo do first?
Male: Hugo, are you free after my lesson?
Hugo: Yes, would you like me to take these books to the library for you?
Man: Thank you, but actually, Mrs Spencer, who works in the office, needs a pupil to take some boxes to the computer room.
Hugo: OK, fine.
Man: Thank you. I've got to show Year 6 how to upload their homework.
parts.5:
Girl: Mum, you know Mateo?
Woman: Yes.
Girl: He's got a new hobby. He's really interested in horror films and he wants to see every one that was made in the last ten years!
Woman: Wow! And what's your best friend Hannah's hobby?
Girl: She plays the guitar in a rock group. I took some photos of them last week.
Woman: Let's see ... Great! What about Christopher, what does he do?
Girl: He's so clever. He went on a climbing holiday in Spain, so he's studying Spanish now. And he's having conversation classes in Arabic, too!
Woman: And Samantha? Is she still interested in building model planes?
Girl: She gave them all to her little brother. She goes to a special club at the swimming pool and now she can use the board that's two metres high!
Woman: Fantastic! What about Andrew?
Girl: He's always in a play at school. He likes playing a bad guy.
Woman: Really? Has Grace got a hobby?
Girl: Yes, you can see an exhibition of her pictures in the school hall next week. I think her best one's of her dad climbing a mountain.
Woman: Great!

explanations.p1q1: 妈妈提议做意面（"would you like some pasta for lunch today?"），也可以拌沙拉，还说昨晚剩了披萨；Pete 回答吃和昨晚一样的就行（"I'm fine with the same as last night."），而昨晚吃的正是披萨（"There's some pizza left ... We didn't eat it all last night."），因此选择 C。
explanations.p1q2: Emily 说新邻居家有一位很友好的奶奶，两个和她年龄相仿的孩子（"There's the grandma, she's really friendly, and two children, about my age"），而且都是女孩（"Just girls."）；图 A 是老爷爷、图 B 是一男一女两个孩子，只有图 C 是奶奶加两个女儿，因此选择 C。
explanations.p1q3: Oscar 说他正在帮爸爸搬卧室里的家具（"I'm helping my dad move the furniture in my bedroom. And then we're going to paint the walls."），搬完之后才打算刷墙；Isabel 问的 "Are you having your dinner?" 提示吃饭也不是此刻在做的事，因此选择 A。
explanations.p1q4: Niesha 生病卧床是她之前错过学校运动会的原因（"I was when I missed the sports day at school"）；这次错过派对是因为全家正开车从度假地返回（"we were driving back from holiday"），因此选择 A。
explanations.p1q5: 手机早些时候在厨房餐桌上（"I think it was on the kitchen table earlier."），之后用过；朋友提醒他常把手机忘在沙发上（"You often leave it on the sofa when you're watching TV."），但最后发现手机在书桌上、被书遮住了所以没看到（"I couldn't see it because of the books."），因此选择 B。
explanations.p2q1: 答案填 tiger。女士说猴子总在动、很难画，所以要画的是老虎："It's difficult to draw a monkey because they move so much, so you're going to draw a tiger."；monkey 只是被提到的“难画”对象，是主要干扰项。
explanations.p2q2: 答案填 10:45。女士说给动物加水的时间是十点四十五："at ten forty-five you're going to go with our staff to give some animals their water"；eleven thirty 是去看最小动物 baby lion 的时间，不要混淆。
explanations.p2q3: 答案填 Sohatu。你们将看到的最小动物是 baby lion："you'll see our youngest animal. He's really beautiful; he's a baby lion. He's called Sohatu."，女士还逐字母拼读 "It's S-O-H-A-T-U."，照拼读抄写即可。
explanations.p2q4: 答案填 37。最老的海豚三十七岁："Some dolphins can live to be sixty years old, but our oldest dolphin is thirty-seven."；sixty 是海豚可以活到的岁数上限，不是这只海豚的实际年龄。
explanations.p2q5: 答案填 poster。女士说当天的礼物是一张海报："we'll give you a present – a poster."；T-shirt 和 toy 只是可以在商店自己买的东西（"You can also go to the shop and buy perhaps a T-shirt or a toy."），不是赠送的礼物。
explanations.p3q1: 海上风太大无法游泳（"It was too windy to swim in the sea"），在河里游只是她们“下次可以试试”的计划（"Perhaps next time we can try the river."）；她们这次是在湖里游得很开心（"the lake was great anyway"），因此选择 C。
explanations.p3q2: Jasmine 说第一晚她很担心（"I was worried about it on the first night"），很快才发现睡帐篷很刺激；unhappy 是没能同行的哥哥的感受（"My brother was very unhappy that he couldn't come with us."），属于干扰项，因此选择 B。
explanations.p3q3: 煎蛋卷很难做（"It was difficult to cook the omelette"），而阿姨说自己喜欢在烧烤架上烤牛排（"I loved grilling the steak on a barbecue."）；意面虽也是阿姨做的、Jasmine 也说好吃，但阿姨明说最爱的是烤牛排，因此选择 B。
explanations.p3q4: 阿姨说营地相当大（"The campsite was quite big"，排除 C），遗憾的是没有地方可买食物和用品（"it's a pity they didn't have anywhere to buy food and things"），即需要一家商店；淋浴只是“有点脏但还可以”（"a bit dirty, but OK"，排除 B），因此选择 A。
explanations.p3q5: Jasmine 说在森林里跑步还行但很累（"running in the forest was OK, but hard."），而钓鱼太棒了，甚至比骑自行车还有趣（"fishing was amazing, even more fun than cycling!"），因此她最喜欢的是钓鱼，选择 B。
explanations.p4q1: Teresa 说阿姨今天开车来接她一起去市中心买生日礼物（"My aunt's picking me up today because we're going into the centre to buy some birthday presents."），阿姨是家庭成员；在那边和体育老师说话的是她的弟弟（"talking to Mr Harrison, the new sports coach"），因此选择 B。
explanations.p4q2: 男孩打电话问妈妈是否同意他放学后去 Frank 家一起做科学项目（"If it's OK with you, I'd like to go to Frank's house after school"）、并留在那里吃晚饭（"I hope you haven't already cooked something for me."），是在征求许可，因此选择 A。
explanations.p4q3: 他本想上网查，但 Wi-Fi 连不上（"the wi-fi wasn't working"）；同学 Sophia 虽去过但不在场，最后两人决定去看图书馆墙上那张大大的告示（"Isn't there a big notice about it on the wall in the library?"、"You're right, let's go and read it."），即海报，因此选择 C。
explanations.p4q4: 天气有点多云（"I don't mind that the weather's a bit cloudy."，排除 B），网上订票并不便宜、只是方便（"It isn't cheaper, but it's more convenient."，排除 A）；真正吸引她们的是 Pablo 叔叔今天在船上给游客讲城镇历史（"he's telling tourists about the history of the town"），想去听他讲，因此选择 C。
explanations.p4q5: Hugo 主动提出帮老师把书送到图书馆（"take these books to the library for you?"），但老师说在办公室工作的 Spencer 女士更需要人把箱子搬到电脑室（"Mrs Spencer, who works in the office, needs a pupil to take some boxes to the computer room."），即先帮学校秘书；给六年级学生演示上传作业（"show Year 6 how to upload their homework"）是老师自己要做的事，因此选择 B。
explanations.p5q1: Hannah 在一个摇滚乐队里弹吉他（"plays the guitar in a rock group."），即参加乐队；“我上周给他们拍了照”（"I took some photos of them last week."）是说话女孩的行为，不要误选摄影。
explanations.p5q2: 他去西班牙参加了一次攀岩假期后，现在正在学西班牙语、还上阿拉伯语会话课（"He went on a climbing holiday in Spain, so he's studying Spanish now. And he's having conversation classes in Arabic, too!"），爱好是学语言；攀岩只是那次旅行的活动。
explanations.p5q3: 她已经把飞机模型都送给了弟弟（"She gave them all to her little brother."），现在去游泳池的专门俱乐部（"goes to a special club at the swimming pool"），还能从两米跳台跳下，爱好是游泳。
explanations.p5q4: 他总在学校的戏剧里演出，而且喜欢扮演坏人（"He's always in a play at school. He likes playing a bad guy."），爱好是表演。
explanations.p5q5: 下周学校大厅将展出她拍摄的照片（"you can see an exhibition of her pictures in the school hall next week."），她最好的作品是爸爸爬山的照片（"her best one's of her dad climbing a mountain."）；爬山的是她爸爸，Grace 的爱好是摄影。
